title: Adeptus Ministorum — Before Philosophy Got Polite #Shorts
description:
What culture calls destiny in Adeptus Ministorum is usually just selection pressure wearing a suit. Warhammer 40,000 (also known as WH40K or 40K), is a British miniature wargame produced by Games Workshop. It is the most popular miniature wargame in the world, and is particularly popular in the United Kingdom.

The bleak reading of Adeptus Ministorum is also the most testable one. For instance, a model of a Space Marine armed with a "boltgun" weapon can shoot any enemy unit within 24 inches. Most of the races in the game have units with psychic powers, who are called psykers.
